summary: Put on a request entity by esv::ServerSoundSystem (bg3.exe+0x2D92180 drains the system's queue of ls::Variant<ServerSoundSystem::PlayRequest, PlayHUDRequest>, 0x18-byte elements with the index at +0x10) and consumed by ServerSoundSystem::ProcessServerSoundRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x4CA630), which forwards it to clients (eoc::notification::PlayServerSoundComponent). macOS: ServerSoundSystem::RequestPlaySound(EntityHandle const&, FixedString const&, bool) / RequestPlayHUDSound. Seen.py context: born at the first shove/throw step together with drop/thrown/steering types; very common afterwards (up to 787 holders).

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Both writers bg3.exe+0x2D922B0 (PlayRequest) and bg3.exe+0x2D924B0 (PlayHUDRequest) copy the request's EntityHandle (+0) after checking IsEntityAlive. Live: entity handles.

fields.name: Event
fields.evidence: Writers copy the request FixedString at +8 with IncRef; ProcessServerSoundRequests destroys a FixedString at +8. RequestPlaySound(entity, FixedString, bool): the sound event name. Live: FixedString indices.

fields.name: SoundObjectType
fields.evidence: PlayRequest writer stores the 0..3 result of a virtual call on the system's sound helper (rejects 2 and >=4); PlayHUDRequest writer stores constant 2. Live: 0..2. Enum name not established (an ESoundObjectType-like value, 4 bytes).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Both writers copy the request byte at +0xC here (the bool of RequestPlaySound / RequestPlayHUDSound). Live: 0/1.

fields.name: field_11
fields.evidence: PlayRequest writer copies request byte +0xD (when it is set, object type 1 is rejected); PlayHUDRequest writer stores 1.

fields.name: _Pad12
fields.evidence: Never written by the creators; live bytes here are uninitialised garbage.

open_questions: Meanings of the two bytes at +0x10/+0x11 and the enum behind +0xC.
